In 
C482 No. 632 of 2015
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sanpreet Singh Ajmani, learned 
counsel for the applicant through video 
conferencing.
2. Mr. B.P.S. Mer, learned Brief Holder 
for the State/respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Kshitij Sah, learned counsel 
holding brief of Mr. Siddhartha Singh, 
learned counsel for respondent no.2.
4. A substitution application has been 
moved by the applicant to bring on record 
the legal heirs of respondent nos. 4 and 5.
5. Learned counsel for the private 
respondent does not want to file any 
objection to the substitution application and 
rather he requested to decide, the matter,
on merits.
6. There is a delay of 44 days’ in filing 
the substitution application, to which also,
no objection, is proposed to be filed by the 
learned counsel for the respondent. Hence, 
the delay condonation application is 
allowed.

substitution application.  8. The substitution application is allowed. 
Let the legal heirs of the deceased 
respondents be brought on record and 
necessary steps for bringing the amended 
memo of parties be filed within a period of 
seven days.
9. List this case on 14.06.2023. 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 17.05.2023
Shubham
